item.title: Eight States Sue OpenAI Over ChatGPT Harm to Kids
item.description: The lawsuits follow Meta's $18 billion settlement over children's safety, extending state scrutiny from social media to AI.

item.title: Jamie Dimon Bars Outside AI Agents From JPMorgan Accounts
item.description: Recent rogue AI agent incidents have raised concerns about letting agents manage personal finances.

item.title: Apple's Handmade Launch and Advertising in the AI Era
item.description: As AI-generated ads multiply, Apple's handmade campaigns show how the people behind the work can become part of the pitch.

item.title: California orders banks to report insurance payout handling for wildfire victims
item.description: Regulators have received over 160 complaints about delayed payouts and warn lenders they could face fines if they don't act faster.
